name: Sprinklr Service
oneLiner: Sprinklr's AI-native contact center platform that brings voice, social, messaging and digital channels (30+ by Sprinklr's count) into one agent console, with AI agents, copilots and quality tools.
bestFor: Large, multi-country brands running big contact centers across voice, social and messaging channels.

updates.text: Spring '26 (26.4) release: Autonomous Evaluation in AI+ Studio runs simulated scenarios against AI agents before launch and keeps scoring them live; Agent Copilot gives proactive real-time nudges to human agents.
Voice AI Agents for spoken interactions announced alongside a beta of six Marketing AI Agents.

features: One console for voice, social, messaging (WhatsApp, LINE, WeChat), email, chat, SMS and review sites
Unified routing by skills, capacity, intent and sentiment
Customer-facing AI agents and voice bots
AI+ Studio to build, test and evaluate AI agents
Conversation analytics on 100% of customer conversations across channels

pricing.text: Custom enterprise pricing; no prices on sprinklr.com, and the product page offers a demo.

notes: sprinklr.com pages not fetched directly; facts from search results of sprinklr.com and press. '30+ channels' is Sprinklr's own marketing figure; its 10-K uses different breakdowns. Customer metrics are vendor-reported and not used in the review. 2026-11 update: sprinklr.com/products/customer-service/ fetched directly (title 'Sprinklr Service: AI Contact Center Platform for Omnichannel CX'): 30+ voice, social and digital channels, AI Agents, Agent Copilot, AI routing, analysis of 100% of conversations, omnichannel surveys with AI CSAT predictions, 25+ social channels, predictive dialers, Sprinklr Voice; vendor ROI claims (210%) not used. sprinklr.com/pricing returns 404. G2 rating 4.3 (774) and the learning-curve and cost complaints come from G2 search snippets (G2 returns 403 to fetches).
pros: 30+ voice, social and digital channels in one agent console
AI agents for routine requests, plus Agent Copilot that suggests replies, pulls articles and summarizes conversations
Social care across 25+ social channels next to calls and messaging
Workforce management, quality management and analytics in the same platform
Rated 4.3 out of 5 on G2 (774 reviews)

cons.text: No published prices; you get a custom quote after a demo
Built for large, multi-country contact centers, so a restaurant group with a small guest relations team may need far less
The most common complaints in G2 reviews are the learning curve and cost
